Lee Newman found the form of his life at Crystal Palace, spinning the discus out to 60.48 to break John Hillier's 21 year-old Kent County record of 56.46 and top Abi Ekoku's Belgrave best by 40cm. Meanwhile, down at Crawley, what a super triple from Nick Dawson - obviously heading for a fine season.
This was the day that Nick Dawson got one over European Junior Champion to be Dwain Chambers! In the heats it had been the other way round as Chambers got home by 1/100th with 21.96/21.97.

We also welcomed Nick Dawson who gained a creditable 4th in the 'B' 200. Added to this were returns to 'A' Team competition for Noel Levy, Jason Fergus, Marcello Bizio and not least old hand Darrell Maynard in the 'A' 800.
This left us without a 'B' 200 runner while our 'A' specialist Nick Dawson also struggled with injury as the cold, windy weather took its toll.
